headline: Dollar strength and Fed tone affect precious metals
summary: Spot gold touched its lowest level since August 28 of last year on Monday and Tuesday, as a firm dollar and the Federal Reserve's tone weighed on precious metals.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to move inversely to the US dollar and to real interest rates, both of which are shaped by Federal Reserve policy.
why_moved: A firm US dollar and the Federal Reserve's tone pressured precious metals, pushing spot gold to its lowest level since late August.
original_headline: Fortaleza del dólar y tono de la Fed afectan a metales preciosos
